text: Doc Present 是一款面向 DSH web 客户端的方案展示插件，通过 `doc_present` 工具和 `/doc-present` 命令管理演示文档，并在会话页眉提供预览抽屉。agent 可从模板创建自包含 HTML 页面，再用常规编辑工具补充方案内容；页面可在 DSH 内嵌面板查看，也可由局域网浏览器打开。插件还支持列出和搜索文档、撤回或重新发布、删除到回收站及恢复。需要 DSH web profile；文档保存在本机，局域网预览服务默认使用 8899 端口。

Doc Present turns plans into interactive HTML previews. The `doc_present` tool creates and manages pages. Users view them in a DSH panel or browser and can search, withdraw, republish, trash, or restore them. Pages stay on the local machine.
想把方案做成可交互的网页演示，在 DSH 里直接预览。
能不能把长篇设计说明改成可以在浏览器打开的 HTML 页面？
I want to present a workflow as an interactive page inside my DSH session.
Doc Present 的功能「方案页预览」：agent 可通过 `doc_present` 新建模板页面，再用常规编辑工具填入 HTML；用户从会话页眉打开抽屉，在内嵌面板或浏览器查看演示。
Doc Present 的功能「文档管理」：通过工具或面板列出、筛选、撤回和重新发布页面；删除默认移入回收站，也可恢复，便于整理已发布的方案。
Doc Present 使用前须知：局域网预览服务监听 `0.0.0.0`，同一网络可访问已发布页面；使用前确认页面内容适合在局域网分享（见 lib/server.js:578-595）。

dsh-doc-present README · dsh-plugin-doc-present：Doc Present for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): let the agent **show** plans and
designs instead of dumping long text into the chat.

When the agent has a proposal to present — an architecture, a flow, a state
machine, a message sequence, a numeric curve, a UI walkthrough — it publishes a
**self-contained interactive HTML page** (inline CSS/JS, `FX` animation
framework included) and you view it in an **in-GUI panel** or any browser,
including colleagues on the LAN.

dsh-doc-present README · dsh-plugin-doc-present：方案展示插件：agent 把方案做成自包含 HTML 动态演示页（状态机/时序/曲线/UI
四类动图配方），你在 GUI 内嵌面板或浏览器里看，替代对话框长文。

dsh-doc-present README · Surfaces：| Surface | What you get |
| --- | --- |
| In-GUI panel | `📄 方案预览` button in the session header opens a drawer with the doc list and a live iframe preview (same-origin route `/doc-present/...` on the dsh web server — no CORS, no extra port needed for local viewing). |
| Tool card | Each `doc_present` tool call renders a card in the conversation with `在面板中打开` / `浏览器打开` / `复制内网链接` buttons. |
| LAN server | A standalone preview server on `0.0.0.0` (default port 8899, auto-scans upward if occupied) so colleagues open `http://<your-LAN-IP>:<port>/<slug>/` directly. Started lazily on first publish; survives nothing but a dsh restart (docs persist on disk; it re-ensures itself on next use). |

dsh-doc-present README · Repository layout：```
package.json          plugin manifest (dsh.client declaration, exports["./client"])
lib/index.js          host half: doc_present tool, /doc-present command, prompt section, /doc-present web route
lib/server.js         document server core (pure Node, no dsh imports — standalone-testable)
lib/client.js         client half: header button + overlay drawer + doc_present tool card

dsh-doc-present README · Repository layout：The doc template, the FX framework, and both guides are ported from the
`design-preview` agent skill; the preview server is a Node port of its
`doc_server.py` with the same lifecycle rules (unpublish → 410, delete →
trash, etc.).

dsh-doc-present README · What a new page looks like：`doc_present(action="new")` copies `assets/template.html` and fills two
placeholders — `__DOC_TITLE__` (HTML-escaped) and `__DOC_DATE__` (local
`YYYY-MM-DD`). It also supports an optional `__DOC_AUTHOR__` slot: it is
blanked, and the now-empty `作者：` span plus its trailing separator are dropped
so the meta line never renders a dangling `作者： ·`. No `__X__` placeholder
ever reaches a rendered page.

Two deliberate properties of the template, both learned from how pages were
actually written:
section: What a new page looks like

text:
dsh-doc-present README · What a new page looks like：- **The prose skeleton is a scaffold, not a spec.** The shipped body is one
  skeleton (design review) plus a minimal `A → B → C` demo, every block marked
  「待改 / 示例」. The real section-shape guidance lives in
  `references/writing-guide.md`: the guides are what agents actually read
  (18/18 publishing sessions), while the template file itself was read once in
  18 sessions.
- **The first line carries a `TEMPLATE-NOT-EDITED` marker** so an unedited page
  is recognizable; removing it (which the header comment tells the writer to
  do) is the signal that the page has real content.

dsh-doc-present README · Installation：This package is a **profile bundle**: `package.json` declares
`dsh.bundle.patch`, and `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the host row. The row
declares `inject: ["tools", "systemPrompt", "commands", "webServer"]`, so it
needs the **web profile** (the `webServer` service only exists there). One
command installs it — it links the package, registers the bundle and enables
the row — and the change applies immediately through HMR:

dsh-doc-present README · Installation：```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=E:\dsh\dsh-plugin-doc-present
```

Do not write the profile's `package.json` or `cordis.patch.yml` by hand, and do
not copy or Junction the package into `$DSH_HOME\profiles\node_modules`.

dsh-doc-present README · Installation：> **Why the old copy/Junction method broke on Desktop 0.2.0:** a package placed
> or linked in `$DSH_HOME\profiles\node_modules` resolves its `@deepseek-ai/*`
> peers against that same shared directory, which the Desktop module resolver
> treats as an **obsolete fallback** and rejects. `install_bundle` links the
> package under the profile instead, so peers resolve from the app's own
> install.

dsh-doc-present README · Installation：Every session gains the `doc_present` tool, the `/doc-present` command, the
prompt section, the header button, the panel, and the tool card.

dsh-doc-present README · Verify：- the row `include:doc-present` reports `enabled: true, fiberPhase: "active"`
  (`plugin_manager action=list_plugins`), then
- refresh the browser once: the `📄 方案预览` button appears in the session
  header (top-right actions row).

Published documents live in the doc root on disk, not in the plugin package, so
reinstalling the bundle leaves every existing document in place.

dsh-doc-present README · For the agent (model tool)：| action | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `new` | Create `<root>/<slug>/index.html` from the template (needs `slug`, optional `title`), ensure the LAN server, return the file path and all URLs. The agent then writes the content with its normal write/edit tools. |
| `status` | Server state, root, port, doc counts, URLs. |
| `ensure` | Start (or reuse/adopt) the LAN server; prints share URLs. |
| `list` | List published docs with update times (`all: true` includes withdrawn, `query: "..."` filters by slug/title). |
| `unpublish` | Take a doc offline (visitors see a 410 page); files kept, restorable. |
| `republish` | Re-publish a withdrawn doc. |
| `delete` | Move a doc to the trash (`hard: true` deletes permanently). |
| `trash` | List the trash (`empty: true` empties it). |
| `restore` | Move a trash item back to the doc root (needs `name` from the trash list). |

dsh-doc-present README · For the agent (model tool)：Authoring rules the agent follows (enforced by the prompt section): a doc is
one **self-contained HTML file** — inline CSS/JS, **no CDN / web fonts /
external images** (LAN readers may not reach the public internet), demos
paused by default with a static caption each, semantic colors (blue = active,
green = done, yellow = attention, red = risk, purple = self-call). The two
guides in `references/` teach the FX framework and the writing structure; the
prompt section points the agent at their absolute paths.

dsh-doc-present README · For the user：- `📄 方案预览` button (session header, top right) — toggle the preview
  drawer: doc chips on top, live preview below; `浏览器打开` / `复制链接` /
  `↔ 全宽` / `⟳` / `✕` in the drawer header; `Esc` closes.
- Doc management in the drawer — a search box filters chips by title/slug;
  the manage bar shows the selected doc's update time and offers `撤回` /
  `重新发布` and `删除` (soft delete into the trash, confirmed first); the
  `回收站` section restores items individually or empties the trash. These
  actions call the loopback-only `POST /doc-present/__api__/manage`
  endpoint, so LAN visitors keep read-only access.
- Tool cards — after the agent publishes, its `doc_present` result renders a
  card with `在面板中打开` (opens the drawer straight at that doc),
  `浏览器打开`, and `复制内网链接`.
- `/doc-present status|start|stop|list` — the service as a command.
  (`/doc-present json` is the machine-readable state the panel uses.)

dsh-doc-present README · How the two servers relate：- The **same-origin route** `/doc-present/...` on the dsh web server (e.g.
  `http://127.0.0.1:3080/doc-present/`) serves the doc root directly from
  disk. It is always on while the plugin is mounted and powers the in-GUI
  panel. Only people who can reach your dsh web server can see it.
- The **standalone LAN server** (default `0.0.0.0:8899`) exists for sharing:
  it is what colleagues open. It starts lazily on the first
  `new`/`ensure`/`start`, stops on `/doc-present stop`, and is closed when
  the plugin unloads (docs persist on disk). If the configured port is taken
  by a foreign process it scans upward (up to +20) and persists the chosen
  port back to `<root>/.server/config.json`; if it finds a healthy
  doc-present instance already on the port, it adopts it instead of starting
  a second one.

dsh-doc-present README · Configuration：- Doc root: `DOC_PRESENT_ROOT` env var, default `~/.dsh/doc-present`
  (docs + `.server/` metadata: `config.json`, `state.json`, `trash/`).
- Port: `DOC_PRESENT_PORT` env var > `<root>/.server/config.json` > `8899`.
- Template and guides resolve relative to the installed package, so keep
  `assets/` and `references/` next to `lib/`.

dsh-doc-present README · Development：`lib/server.js` is pure Node and covered by a standalone smoke test (new →
serve → unpublish/410 → republish → delete/trash → port persistence):

```powershell
node scripts/smoke.mjs
```

dsh-doc-present README · Development：Client-half edits hot-reload only while a watcher rebuilds plugin bundles
(`pnpm run dev:web` from the dsh checkout); otherwise refresh the page after
copying the package into the profile. Host-half changes load when the row
reloads (edit the patch file) — note that `webServer.register` returns a raw
disposer, and while the plugin captures and disposes its route on unload, a
route leaked by an older build is detected and reused (a warning is logged);
restart the profile for a completely clean slate.
